tesscut_replay.if_regenerated_fits_sha_changes: Continue only if frozen A/B/C TIME, CADENCENO and QUALITY=0 match the T3A manifest exactly within time tolerance 1e-9 day; record content-hash change explicitly.

fixed_aperture.target_region: geometric central 3x3 pixels of the 11x11 TESSCut, fixed for all cadences
fixed_aperture.background_region: pixels with Chebyshev distance >=4 from geometric center
fixed_aperture.scalar_flux: sum(target 3x3 of FLUX-FLUX_BKG when FLUX_BKG exists, otherwise FLUX) minus 9 times median(background region of same cadence)

cadence_native_statistic.robust_sigma: 1.4826*MAD; fallback sample standard deviation only if MAD is zero and finite control count is sufficient

candidate_gate.identity_limit: A candidate is an aperture-time-series event only; it is not by itself a counterpart, star identity, particle, transient class, or astrophysical origin.

sensitivity_gate_for_null.reason: Avoid a threshold-boundary floating-point artifact while still requiring strong deterministic recovery above the frozen 8-sigma candidate threshold.

trial_classification.CANDIDATE_REQUIRES_ADJUDICATION: Raw frozen B passes the candidate gate.
trial_classification.QUALIFIED_NO_ISOLATED_B_EVENT: Raw B fails candidate gate, controls are valid, and +10sigma and +12sigma injected B both pass the unchanged candidate gate.
trial_classification.NON_ISOLATED_OR_VARIABLE_PATTERN: Raw B has z>=8 but fails one or both neighbor-dominance requirements.

experiment_status.PASS_ALL_42_PREPOINTED_NULL: 42 qualified no-isolated-B trials and zero candidates/nonisolated/unresolved.
experiment_status.BLOCKED_PREPOINTED_REPLICATION_INCOMPLET: No raw candidate but at least one nonisolated or unresolved trial.

not_admitted: No claim that the central 3x3 aperture isolates a unique astrophysical source at TESS resolution.
No claim that a null excludes events below the preregistered aperture sensitivity.
No global rejection of transient phenomena.
No physical tachyon identification, faster-than-light propagation, retrocausality, UAP origin, artificial origin, ETI, or nuclear causality.
